mechanism = physical (neural recording + processing) not abstract practical-reason faculty | claim=Besides guidance control (causal triggering via covert speech), regulative control over the synthetic speech output is required if synthetic speech is to be responsive to the user's reasons for speaking - i.e. for responsibility and ownership of speech action | Claim.claim_scope=Analyzed via articulatory-motor covert-speech prosthesis as representative;
